finding.claim: SQL injection in /search: the q parameter is interpolated into an f-string SQL query.

trace.note: term interpolated into the SQL string and executed with no parameterization

finding.guards_checked: No validation, escaping, or allowlist on term; no authentication on the route; not parameterized (unlike the other two routes, which use ? placeholders). A payload like ' UNION SELECT id, name FROM sqlite_master-- reads arbitrary tables.

verdict.reason: app.py:11 reads q from request.args and app.py:12 interpolates it into an f-string SQL query run by db.execute, with no auth, validation or parameterization on the /search route (unlike the ? placeholders at app.py:18 and app.py:25).
